cim: FSB Regional Consultative Group for Asia meets in Sydney
cim_eredeti: FSB Regional Consultative Group for Asia meets in Sydney
szoveg_eredeti:
The Financial Stability Board (FSB) Regional Consultative Group for Asia (RCG Asia) met on 23–24 November 2026 in Sydney, hosted by the Reserve Bank of Australia. The meeting brought together senior officials from central banks, financial authorities and regulatory bodies across the region to discuss key financial stability issues.

Members also discussed regional messages to be communicated to the FSB Plenary and how regional perspectives could contribute to the FSB’s broader work. The meeting followed a technical-level workshop on cross-border payments, which brought together public- and private-sector participants, and examined correspondent banking, digital payment innovations, payment-system interlinking and jurisdictional actions to improve cross-border payments.
